source.citation: Blasius smooth-pipe law f_D = 0.316 Re^(-1/4), evaluated at the geometric-mean Reynolds number of the run
source.validRange: Hydraulically smooth circular section, 4e3 <= Re <= 1e5. Over the run F = 0.40-0.48 kg/s and the liquid viscosity (about 0.32-1.3 mPa s between 300 K and 365 K, estimate) give Re about 1.3e4-6.3e4, so f_D varies 0.020-0.030; holding 0.024 changes the total loss coefficient by at most about 8 %.
